نتكامل (form VI)
# نَتَكَامَلُ (natakāmalu) /na.ta.kaː.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَامَلَ (takāmala)
# نَتَكَامَلَ (natakāmala) /na.ta.kaː.ma.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَامَلَ (takāmala)
# نَتَكَامَلْ (natakāmal) /na.ta.kaː.mal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَامَلَ (takāmala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
